draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 210th-best grade among 253 2019 draftees and 24th of 28 at WR. He went 208th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,148 receiving yards in 2018, 9th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 93 career games and 9 starts over 7 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 5 in 2020. Weak spots: receiving yards 62 (12th percentile), receiving td 0 (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-7 wide receiver who played: 62 receiving yards against a median of 321, below the norm.
